name: Jonathan Procter
story: Massey University's research record names Jonathan Procter as a co-author of Towards developing and applying an Iwi/Hapū based GIS system, presented at the Māori GIS Conference in Christchurch in May 2009. Other credited authors include Garth Harmsworth and additional collaborators. The record establishes a research and conference contribution, but does not by itself allocate specific software development or conference organising roles to Procter.
